name: Wild Flower Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Wild Flowers Solitaire is a delightfully decorated solitaire game based on flowers. This is a basic online solitaire game set against a garden-themed image for a relaxing gaming session. Some of the cards are also decorated in brightly colored flowers. Select Help to review the solitaire rules if you are a new player or just want to review this game’s rules. Each session is timed so the quicker you solve the game, the better your score. Play, again and again, and challenge yourself to beat your own best score. Rise up the leaderboards and prove yourself to be one of the best solitaire game players on AddictingGames.
